author: Anthony Costa
description: There are 57 million people worldwide living with dementia today. For the researchers working to help them, the obstacle isn’t a lack of effort — it’s too much data, too few experts to synthesize it and a pace of discovery that can’t keep up with the disease.  The Consortium for Biomedical Research and AI in […]
title: How AI Is Changing the Pace of Discovery for Millions Living With Dementia
